title: Fastmail website, 2020
lede: Fastmail’s 2020 home page: a woman with long legs relaxes at a laptop on a balcony full of plants, in a flat yellow hero with a curved lower edge.
summary: A relaxed long-limbed figure among potted plants on a flat yellow field with a curved edge. 2020.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. No cookie box covers the page. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Borderline: a flat scene with a long-legged figure, potted plants, and oversized sneakers on a pale color field, but the skin is natural and some shapes carry a light grain.

notice: The live Fastmail site has changed since this 2020 capture.
observed: A dark navy bar holds the logo and navigation; a square blue “Sign up” button sits at the right.
The hero is a flat pale yellow field whose lower edge is a wide convex curve.
The heading “Email you can feel good about” is bold dark grey sans-serif; a square-cornered blue button reads “Try it free for 30 days”.
On the right, a woman with brown skin and long black hair sits with crossed legs in a white chair, holding a cup beside a pink laptop. Her shoes lie on the floor below.
Potted plants in pink and blue pots, a pale yellow city skyline, and trees surround her; some leaves and pots have a fine grain.
interpretation: The page takes the style’s plants, pastel field, and relaxed long-limbed figure and gives it a natural skin tone, a variant common after 2019.
borrow: End the hero color field with one wide convex curve instead of a straight edge.

images.alt: Fastmail home page, 2020: a pale yellow hero with the heading “Email you can feel good about” on the left and a long-legged woman relaxing at a pink laptop among potted plants and a pale skyline on the right.
images.caption: First viewport of [Fastmail](https://web.archive.org/web/20200701220517/https://www.fastmail.com/).
